text: Your badge is on my desk. It has your photo from the interview. You look terrified in it. It's laminated, so it's permanent.
Oh no. Thank you, I'll grab it!
Lamby did that one. Respect it.
Sorry to bother you, is there a stapler I can borrow? The one in sales staples one sheet then gives up.
You can use the supply closet stapler. You cannot use *the* stapler. The red one is mine. It has a name and it's not your business.
Understood. Supply closet stapler. Not the red one.
You're going to do fine here.
Party planning is Thursday at 3 if you want to join. There are cookies. The cookies are a bribe for labor.
Hanging streamers while Gordon "supervises". Bring patience.
